title: OSError while running the nightly sync (blob.write)
body:
## Environment

Running Lattice 3.3.7 on Debian 12 against eu-west-2.

## Steps

How to trigger it:
- Open Lattice and begin running the nightly sync.
- Run two jobs in parallel against one folder.
- Wait for the failure and read the log.

## Expected

Expected running the nightly sync to finish without errors.

## Actual

The file is reported missing although it exists a moment later. It only happens
when two jobs touch the same folder at once.

## Frequency

It occurs roughly one run in three.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:48 in loop
lattice/sched/runner.py:128 in run_due
lattice/store/remote.py:77 in sync_all
lattice/store/blob.py:252 in write
OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device
